title: auto-ship fires on review CLEAN without checking pending operator stories — awaiting-operator gate is bypassed
description: In auto mode (plan_approval=auto), autoShipFn is called immediately when review.lastVerdict==CLEAN (loop.ts:1354), before the next decideNextAction iteration that would detect pending operator stories and return await-operator. A hand-filed operator-ceremony story with requires:operator does NOT gate the ship as documented. The await-operator terminal state is correct per the stop-condition spec but the auto-ship callsite runs one iteration earlier, in the review branch, before the loop re-evaluates story completeness.

spec.scope: Re-ancorar a decisao de auto-ship do supervisor loop no estado terminal complete && review.lastVerdict==='CLEAN' (nao na edge transiente review->CLEAN), com marcador persistido review.autoShipDispatchedAt no prd.json garantindo fire-once entre re-invocacoes e restart do sidecar. Conserta BUG B (reachability: o loop retorna complete no topo e nunca chega no callsite atual em loop.ts) e BUG A (over-fire: complete e inalcancavel com operator story pendente, que roteia para await-operator em decide.ts, entao o gate cai de graca). Fora de escopo: teardown do worker/reviewer pane pendurado (follow-up separado), o exercicio end-to-end do auto-drain do CAM-139 (rebuild+container+meta_loop=auto), merge-watch/post-merge, e CAM-187.
acceptanceCriteria: opts.autoShipFn() nao vive mais no branch action.kind==='review'; vive no branch terminal 'complete', gated em review.lastVerdict==='CLEAN'.
PRD com story requires:'operator' pendente e review CLEAN roteia para await-operator e autoShipFn NAO e chamado (test novo).
Re-entrada com review.lastVerdict==='CLEAN' ja persistido e todas as stories passando dispara auto-ship exatamente uma vez (test do path BUG B).
Duas invocacoes de runSupervisor sobre o mesmo prd complete+CLEAN chamam autoShipFn 1x no total; o marcador review.autoShipDispatchedAt guarda o re-dispatch (test cross-invocacao).
Terminal 'complete' alcancado via MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT (nao CLEAN) NAO dispara auto-ship (test).
review.autoShipDispatchedAt e escrito no prd.json antes do dispatch e removido no finalize (git rm do prd), de modo que um ciclo novo re-arma.
docs/adr/0008-*.md documenta a ancoragem terminal, o dedup persistido e a divergencia principiada do CAM-68 (dedup in-memory).
bun run check:all EXIT 0 (typecheck + biome + tests).
gotchas: O branch terminal complete da return imediato, entao a dedup intra-invocacao e moot; o risco real e re-fire cross-invocacao / restart do sidecar (swap de binario in-place), por isso marcador PERSISTIDO e nao o flag in-memory blockedCycleEmitted do CAM-139 US-005.
complete tambem e alcancado com lastVerdict==='MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' (debt terminal + promoteVerdictTo); o conjunto ==='CLEAN' e OBRIGATORIO para excluir (debt escala, nao shippa).
Nao adicionar check redundante de operator no callsite: complete e inalcancavel enquanto houver story requires:'operator' pendente (roteiam para await-operator em decide.ts:145-153).

O /cam-ship que o autoShipFn injeta no pane do orquestrador roda o markdown do slash-command e NAO consulta o paneCountMutex; so o thin-proxy externo cam ship recusa por 3-panes (ship.ts:161-166). Logo o pane pendurado nao bloqueia o auto-ship (teardown e higiene, follow-up separado).
O supervisor ja e dono das escritas em prd.review (verdicts); adicionar autoShipDispatchedAt ali e consistente. A regra 'orquestrador nao modifica prd.json' nao se aplica ao supervisor.
test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts cobre CLEAN->autoShipFn mas todo PRD usa uma unica story requires:null: os paths A (operator-gate) e B (re-entrada) estao SEM cobertura, adicionar.
